name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
value: Cyclone Akvan due ashore in Andhra 20 Nov
summary: Cyclone Akvan is forecast to cross the Andhra Pradesh coast on 20 Nov; GDACS lowered it to green on 19 Nov
state: IMD forecast on 17 Nov that Cyclone Akvan would cross the Andhra Pradesh coast between Nellore and Tuni around midday on 20 Nov, with winds of 120–130 km/h gusting to 145 km/h; coastal Andhra is on high alert and Odisha has begun evacuations (The South First). GDACS lowered Akvan from orange to green in its 19 Nov 18:00 UTC update. A cyclone threatening land within 72h keeps Watch; the expected impact is easing.
for_you: People in coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha should follow India Meteorological Department and state disaster authority warnings. Travellers should check FCDO travel advice for India.
rubric_hit: Cyclone threatening land within 72h = Watch (GDACS green, no orange alert)
basis_detail: raised above the data floor on reported events

sources.title: The South First — Cyclone Akvan to make landfall between Nellore and Tuni on 20 November

why: Typhoons and cyclones are the deadliest weather events, threatening densely populated coasts in Asia and the Indian Ocean.
drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
